mathematical_contract.rebuilt_maps: A map copy is reusable only when cusp parameter, retained incidence, diameter-side equation, radius denominator, speed equation where applicable, and policy are structurally equal. Cache identity and contact correlation are not mathematical map identity and are excluded.
mathematical_contract.reversed_maps: A reversed map is reusable only when every retained bivariate equation equals the other equation after exact substitution t -> 1-t. The transported isolated parameter is complemented exactly and retains its defining polynomial and reversed isolator.
mathematical_contract.cross_type_cut: For a proposed same or complemented native parameter, compare the normalized rational diameter coordinate Rr/Qr with the analytic coordinate (Ra+B/sqrt(S))/Qa. Cross multiplication produces A+B/sqrt(S); exact evaluation at the selected cusp root and the isolated algebraic cut must be Zero under the original unsquared radical predicate. A squared equation is never used to authorize transport.
mathematical_contract.range: A transported target parameter is published only after exact refinement proves it lies in the destination overlap's closed native range. A parameter outside that range remains a topology failure rather than silently extending the component.
mathematical_contract.policy: All selected-root equality, bivariate signs, radical magnitudes, isolated-parameter comparisons, complements, and range checks receive CurveContext. STRICT accepts exact evidence only. APPROXIMATE_512 can terminate only at the common 512-bit predicate boundary and records that use.
mathematical_contract.fallback: If neither structural same/reversed identity nor an unsquared same/complement cross-type equality is proved, exact-rational recovery and the existing selected-field inverse remain available. A genuinely algebraic arbitrary correspondence stays explicit Unsupported; no finite approximation is substituted.
